verdict.rationale: CSC's own docs say it offers APIs, both bi-directional integrations for entity management and SOP integrations with ELM, claims and payroll systems. Nothing shows the API covers the full range of UI functions (dashboard, Compliance Calendar, document generation, filings, structure charts), and probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: documented API reference, evidence of UI–API parity across features, public API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Enable secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs
CSC provides integration services for systems like enterprise legal management (ELM), claims, and payroll through secure application programming interfaces (APIs).
